- Paste a URL to automatically fetch its page title, description, and favicon.
- Fetched text remains fully editable.
- Real site icons appear on saved cards, with the letter icon as a fallback.
- Clear loading, success, and error feedback is shown.
- Private/local URLs are blocked for safety.

Verified end-to-end against live webpages with no console errors.
